scope: one bounded Edge AppContainer compatibility candidate; no product backend change
candidate: replace the earlier local file URL with a complete inline data URL containing a JavaScript DOM marker
diagnostics: PathService key 112 failed with Windows error 0x3F0 (ERROR_NO_TOKEN).
The browser created files in its fresh profile, including Local State and Default, so the warning alone does not establish that all profile I/O is blocked.
interpretation: Avoiding page-file access did not produce a rendered DOM. A page-file permission adjustment alone is not an established solution.
Official Chromium base_paths_win.h maps 112 to DIR_LOCAL_APP_DATA; this is consistent with the Edge warning but is not proof that it caused the timeout.
No direct evidence identified a failing desktop/window-station call, GPU child policy, or browser IPC call. Those causes remain unresolved.

boundedWork.reason: No additional evidence-supported fix was identified; no repeat of the same failing launch or sandbox-disabling flags was attempted.

conclusion: Edge GUI/headless DOM compatibility remains unverified and the candidate launch failed its scoped check. Command-line application successes cannot be used as GUI compatibility evidence.
